footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to WEBTOON Entertainment: includes a $16.0M income tax benefit, $27.5M of losses allocated to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 2.5% to $1.4B in 2025. Gross margin was 23.3%, versus 25.1% a year earlier, and the operating loss narrowed to $63.5M from $101M.
The net loss widened to $346M, or −$2.66 per share, from $144M. Operating cash flow was $11.2M and free cash flow $3.6M, versus $15.5M.
sources: WEBTOON Entertainment Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
